@9811 := "# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\nname: pages\n\non:\n  pull_request:\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true\n\njobs:\n  studio:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 30\n    permissions:\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          persist-credentials: false\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: |\n            target/release/verdant_studio\n            target/release/verdant_readers\n            target/release/verdant_xml\n            target/release/verdant_admit\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**', 'certified-readers/**', 'certified-xml/**', 'certified-admit/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      # Restored on every run, not only when certified/ changed: the end-to-end propose-command step below\n      # exports with the attested lexlean binary, and a fresh cargo install does not reproduce its hash.\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3-rust-1.97.0\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          [ \"$(sha256sum target/lexlean/bin/lexlean 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64)\" = \"$(jq -r .lexlean.executable_sha256 certified/evidence/attestation.json)\" ] || { rm -rf target/lexlean; rustup toolchain install 1.97.0 --profile minimal; RUSTFLAGS=\"--remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=cargo-home\" cargo +1.97.0 install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean; }\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n          # The reader operations are a second LexLean project with its own bundle, so that each export stays under its limits.\n          if [ -d certified-readers ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-readers\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # The XML readers are a third project with their own bundle, for the same reason.\n          if [ -d certified-xml ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-xml\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # The admission operations are a fourth project with their own bundle, for the same reason.\n          if [ -d certified-admit ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-admit\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-admit/packages/rust-std/verdant_admit/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-admit/packages/rust-std/verdant_admit/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # Building may write only target/: a stray file in a bundle fails verify-artifact on the next run (LLV7102).\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- certified certified-readers certified-xml certified-admit)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::building the certified commands left files in certified/, certified-readers/, certified-xml/ or certified-admit/:\"\n            git status --short -- certified certified-readers certified-xml certified-admit | head -20\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      # verify-artifact replays a bundle but does not compare it with the sources. So each LexLean project's\n      # semantic id must equal the one its bundle records. Lock-level ids move with every admission to app/,\n      # which readers depends on without using it, so they are not compared.\n      - name: the certified bundles were exported from these sources (semantic ids, no Lean)\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          ll=\"$PWD/target/lexlean/bin/lexlean\"\n          for pair in studio:certified readers:certified-readers readers/xml:certified-xml; do\n            project=$(cut -d : -f 1 <<< \"$pair\")\n            bundle=$(cut -d : -f 2 <<< \"$pair\")\n            if [ ! -f \"$project/lexlean.toml\" ]; then continue; fi\n            if [ ! -f \"$bundle/result.json\" ]; then echo \"::warning::$project has no committed bundle $bundle, so nothing records what it was exported from\"; continue; fi\n            now=$(cd \"$project\" && \"$ll\" lock >/dev/null && \"$ll\" check | sed -n 's/.*semantic \\([0-9a-f]*\\)).*/\\1/p')\n            git checkout -q -- \"$project/lexlean.lock\"\n            was=$(jq -r .source.semantic_id \"$bundle/result.json\")\n            if [ \"$now\" != \"$was\" ]; then echo \"::error::$project now has semantic id $now, but $bundle was exported from $was: export it again through propose-command\"; exit 1; fi\n            echo \"$project matches $bundle (semantic $now)\"\n          done\n      - name: check, build and publish through the API\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n          # Each encoding admitted through admit-translated recorded the reader command that printed it: run it again and fail if the output differs.\n          target/release/verdant_readers verify-translations model/admissions.json\n          if [ -x target/release/verdant_xml ]; then target/release/verdant_xml verify-translations model/admissions.json; fi\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n          if ! git diff --quiet; then echo \"::error::publish changed $(git diff --name-only | tr '\\n' ' '): run every operation through operate, which ends with check, build and publish\"; exit 1; fi\n      - name: next answers within a second, because operate's advance runs it on every push to main\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          best=999999\n          for attempt in 1 2 3; do\n            start=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            target/release/verdant_studio next > target/next.txt || true\n            end=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            took=$(( (${end/./} - ${start/./}) / 1000 ))\n            if [ \"$took\" -lt \"$best\" ]; then best=$took; fi\n          done\n          echo \"next took ${best} ms, the best of 3 runs\"\n          if [ \"$best\" -gt 1000 ]; then echo \"::error::next took ${best} ms, over its 1 s budget: make the reads it repeats cheaper before adding more\"; exit 1; fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.elan\n          key: lean-4.32.2-elan-4.1.2\n      - name: run propose-command end to end when the pull request changes the API's own workflows\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          BASE: ${{ github.base_ref }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          # The studio check proves the model and replays the certified bundle, but the API's own paths\n          # run in these workflows. So a change to them must pass operate's propose-command step itself,\n          # on a fixture change, and that export must reproduce certified/ byte for byte.\n          git fetch -q --depth=1 origin \"$BASE\"\n          if git diff --quiet FETCH_HEAD -- .github; then echo \"the workflows are main's, which main's own runs exercise\"; exit 0; fi\n          mkdir -p target\n          python3 -c 'import yaml; steps = yaml.safe_load(open(\".github/workflows/operate.yml\"))[\"jobs\"][\"operate\"][\"steps\"]; print([step[\"run\"] for step in steps if step.get(\"name\", \"\").startswith(\"apply a change\")][0])' > target/propose.sh\n          d=dev\n          none=null\n          {\n            echo \"Fixture change for the studio check's end-to-end run of propose-command.\"\n            echo\n            echo \"diff --git a/features/suites/e2e.fixture b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"new file mode 100644\"\n            echo \"--- /$d/$none\"\n            echo \"+++ b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"@@ -0,0 +1 @@\"\n            echo \"+fixture\"\n          } > target/fixture.patch\n          INPUT=\"$(cat target/fixture.patch)\" bash target/propose.sh\n          rm -f features/suites/e2e.fixture\n          # certified-xml/ and certified-admit/ join the comparison once main holds them: the export that first writes it is the one that adds it.\n          bundles=\"certified certified-readers\"\n          if [ -n \"$(git ls-files certified-xml | head -n 1)\" ]; then bundles=\"$bundles certified-xml\"; fi\n          if [ -n \"$(git ls-files certified-admit | head -n 1)\" ]; then bundles=\"$bundles certified-admit\"; fi\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- $bundles)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::operate's propose-command step ran, but its export did not reproduce certified/:\"\n            git status --short -- $bundles | head -20\n            attested=$(git show HEAD:certified/evidence/attestation.json | jq -r .lexlean.executable_sha256); used=$(sha256sum target/lexlean/bin/lexlean | cut -c1-64)\n            [ \"$attested\" = \"$used\" ] || echo \"::error::the export ran with lexlean $used, but certified/ attests lexlean $attested. lexlean is built with rust 1.97.0 and its cargo home remapped, so a different hash means the toolchain or the runner image changed\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          echo \"propose-command applied the fixture, exported again with Lean and reproduced certified/ byte for byte\"\n      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API (last, so every seal step reports first)\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'\n          if [ \"$AUTHOR\" != \"$app\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error title=provenance::$AUTHOR opened this pull request, not $app through operate. Every seal step above passed; only the provenance gate refuses it.\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          others=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits\" --paginate --jq \".[] | select(.author.login != \\\"$app\\\") | .sha\")\n          if [ -n \"$others\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'push'\n        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1\n        with:\n          path: app/.prism/site\n\n  pages:\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    needs: studio\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    permissions:\n      pages: write\n      id-token: write\n    environment:\n      name: github-pages\n      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}\n    steps:\n      - id: deployment\n        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5\n"

@9935 := "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\n# The one Lean export of the certified command. operate's propose-command and refresh both run it,\n# and the studio check runs propose-command end to end, so a change that breaks it fails there.\n# Export time is a requirement: every Lean phase runs under child_timeout_ms (300 s, studio/lexlean.toml),\n# so this script measures each phase and fails at 240 s, 80 percent of that limit, before time can creep up to it.\nset -euo pipefail\nll=\"$1\"\nlog=\"$2\"\nphases=\"$log.phases\"\n: > \"$phases.raw\"\n( while :; do ps -eo etimes=,args= | awk '$2 == \"lean\" && $3 == \"-R\" { m = $NF; sub(\".*-src/\", \"\", m); print $1, m }' >> \"$phases.raw\" || true; sleep 1; done ) &\nwatch=$!\nstatus=0\n# Each LexLean project exports under its own limits: studio, readers, admit and readers/xml when they exist, largest first.\n# Lean's proof of a project grows with the square of its function count, so the readers are split by family and admission is its own project.\n# Each export runs two Lean phases at once, so at most half as many exports as cores run together: more slows every phase.\nslots=$(( $(nproc) / 2 ))\nif [ \"$slots\" -lt 1 ]; then slots=1; fi\nrunning=0\nfor project in studio readers admit readers/xml; do\n  if [ -f \"$project/lexlean.toml\" ]; then\n    if [ \"$running\" -ge \"$slots\" ]; then wait -n || status=$?; running=$((running - 1)); fi\n    (cd \"$project\" && \"$ll\" lock && \"$ll\" check && \"$ll\" production build --request production-request.json) > \"$log.${project//\\//-}\" 2>&1 &\n    running=$((running + 1))\n  fi\ndone\nwhile [ \"$running\" -gt 0 ]; do wait -n || status=$?; running=$((running - 1)); done\ncat \"$log.studio\" > \"$log\"\nif [ -f \"$log.readers\" ]; then cat \"$log.readers\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nif [ -f \"$log.readers-xml\" ]; then cat \"$log.readers-xml\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nif [ -f \"$log.admit\" ]; then cat \"$log.admit\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nkill \"$watch\" 2> \"$phases.err\" || true\nawk '{ if ($1 > t[$2]) t[$2] = $1 } END { for (m in t) print t[m], m }' \"$phases.raw\" | sort -rn > \"$phases\"\necho \"Lean phases by wall time in seconds, longest first (the limit is 300, and the export fails at 240):\"\nhead -n 8 \"$phases\"\nif [ \"$status\" -ne 0 ]; then exit \"$status\"; fi\nworst=$(head -n 1 \"$phases\" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\nif [ -n \"$worst\" ] && [ \"$worst\" -ge 240 ]; then\n  echo \"::error::a Lean phase took ${worst} s, within 20 percent of the 300 s limit: make its declarations cheaper to prove before adding more\"\n  exit 1\nfi\nrm -rf certified\ncp -r studio/.lexlean/production/*/ certified\nrm -f certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.lock\n\"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified\nif [ -f readers/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-readers\n  cp -r readers/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-readers\n  rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-readers\nfi\nif [ -f readers/xml/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-xml\n  cp -r readers/xml/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-xml\n  rm -f certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-xml\nfi\nif [ -f admit/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-admit\n  cp -r admit/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-admit\n  rm -f certified-admit/packages/rust-std/verdant_admit/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-admit\nfi\n"
